title: Orientation cube
description: A ceramic orange cube orbits under the pointer and snaps to named faces.
useCase: Spatial orientation controls and small product or object inspectors.
interaction: Drag the cube, use arrow keys, or choose a face
reducedMotion: Face changes settle immediately. Direct pointer and keyboard rotation remain available.
limitations: CSS six-face object, not a mesh renderer or twisty-puzzle simulator.
look: Pale grey-blue page with a matte orange cube whose faces carry thin outlined shapes and labels, a soft floor shadow and three white buttons.
motion: Dragging orbits the cube directly at 0.65° per pixel, pitch clamped to ±90°; face buttons turn it to that face by the shortest path over 500 ms, ease-out.
adapt: The cube is CSS `preserve-3d`: `angle` drives `rotateX(${angle.x}deg) rotateY(${angle.y}deg)` on `sf-orientation-cube`, eased by `transition:transform 500ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` unless `data-instant` is set. Replace the `CUBE_FACES` artwork and the `faces` snap targets; drag sensitivity is the 0.65 factor.
